method.name: fresh-factored-verification-with-full-criticism
method.control: Competent full investigator, fresh independent full critic, fresh full reviser. Same model/provider and75-minute whole ceiling as treatment.
method.treatment: Investigator does the same full external-discovery job, then writes verification-questions.md with three neutral answer-free consequential questions selected from its complete draft. A fresh verifier reads only those questions, original brief and released plan; independently researches primary sources without draft/author sources. It runs in parallel with a separate fresh full critic. Fresh full reviser adjudicates both complete packages with primary evidence and preserves full output. Four contexts, no nested agents; factored verification is extra charged work, not premium evaluation.
method.method_effect: Added independent factored context and neutral-question handoff; not an isolated prompt effect. Matched provider per block, Luna on I07 and Muse on I08.
method.lineage: Prospective successor from observed false critic corrections, not a repair of M05/M13/M14 originals. Adaptation of independent verification-answer separation in CoVe; no benchmark/model/training reproduction. No further novelty credit needed for original four new recipes.

source.observed: Primary abstract describes draft, verification questions, independent answers and final verified response. Its benchmark gains do not establish a full external-discovery planning gain.

method.selection: Two development blocks only. Retire from promotion if either treatment has a material source failure or the required independent-answer barrier fails. Confirmation may be considered only after both treatment full-source passes, >=20% strict eligible both-PASS delivery gain, complete runnable recipe and no known regression. No holdout opened now.
